title: Spring Induction Ceremony
description: Welcome our newest members with the traditional blue & gold pinning ceremony, followed by a reception with faculty and alumni mentors.

title: Mock Trial Workshop
description: Sharpen your courtroom skills with hands-on mock trial exercises led by practicing attorneys from the Nassau County DA's office.

title: Community Service Day
description: Join us for our semester service project partnering with Long Island Cares to support local families in need.

title: Career Panel: Paths in Justice
description: Hear from alumni working in law enforcement, legal aid, corrections, and private practice about their career journeys.

title: Research Symposium
description: Present your criminal justice research and receive feedback from faculty reviewers. Cash prizes for top presentations.
